messages:
sam: Heads-up: found a nasty dup-upload case in the Java sample when uploading large files over flaky networks. Pixel 6, Android 13 and emulator.

sam: Using Retrofit + OkHttp, multipart upload with a streaming RequestBody (no content-length). If the HTTP/2 stream is reset mid-upload, the client sometimes retries and the server ends up receiving repeated chunks (duplicate file parts).

sam: Minimal RequestBody we use: 
```
val body = object: RequestBody() {
  override fun contentType() = "image/jpeg".toMediaType()
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) {
    val fis = FileInputStream(file)
    fis.source().use { src -> sink.writeAll(src) }
  }
}
```

sam: Logs: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST /upload id=77 (chunked)
I/OkHttp: <-- HTTP/2 streamReset (ERR_INADEQUATE_TRANSPORT_SECURITY)
I/OkHttp: RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor: recovering for stream reset
I/OkHttp: --> POST /upload id=78 (retry)
I/Server: received part 1 (0-1MB)
I/Server: received part 2 (1-2MB)
I/Server: received part 1 (duplicate 0-1MB) <-- duplicate
```

priya: OkHttp docs say non-repeatable bodies cannot be retried safely; but I thought RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor doesn't retry non-idempotent requests. Could the HTTP/2 reset be causing a re-open of the connection and our custom interceptors to resend?

josh: Two quick checks: 1) ensure ConnectionRetryInterceptor or any custom retry layer isn't re-enqueuing the same request object; 2) verify writeTimeout vs callTimeout interplay. If writeTimeout triggers a cancel and higher-level logic does a fresh call, non-repeatable body will stream again creating duplicates.

sam: Confirmed we have a small custom network-retry wrapper in the SDK layer that will re-execute the suspend call on transient IOExceptions. It didn't check request.repeatable semantics. For POST file uploads this is bad.

priya: Short-term mitigation: mark uploads as non-retriable in our wrapper and add a buffering option for small files (use contentLength and BufferingRequestBody). Also document that streaming RequestBody isn't retry-safe.

josh: Long-term: add an API flag upload.retriesAllowed=false and a helper to compute content-length (or prebuffer to temp file) when retries=true. Also add a test that simulates HTTP/2 stream reset in CI.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/512 (attach logs + small repro). Nightly job to run flaky upload scenario planned.

sam: Will push a small fix to the sample app: 1) disable auto-retry for multipart POSTs, 2) add README note about repeatability. Thanks all :thumbsup:
